issue.title: CommonTermsQuery fix for ignored coordination factor

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
CommonTermsQueryParser does not check for disable_coords, only for
disable_coord. Yet the builder only outputs disable_coords, leading to
disabling the coordination factor to be ignored in the Java API.

Closes #11730
